items.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23
items.q: The transcript mentions 'His brother' in the context of discussing Buttsy Miller, but the interviewee does not mention any personal interaction or relationship with the brother, only knowing Buttsy.

ctx.x: I don't know if Son's dead. I mean, I don't think Buttsy's dead, but I believe Son's dead. But, uh, nobody wrote and told me about him being dead. And I asked about Buttsy. Oh, Buttsy's son is dead. Yeah. I asked about Buttsy, but Buttsy ain't dead. Him.

No, he's dead. What's his real name, Buttsy? Well, that's every damn thing I ever know. Yeah, I know him for everybody. Yeah, that's the only name I ever know is Buttsy. And Son Miller? Buttsy Miller. And, so he had a, his name was William. His name after his dad. William Miller. William Miller.
